stem: Based on the poster and your knowledge of U.S. history, which factor explains the decreased availability of certain foods during this time period?

options.label: A
options.text: The conversion of most U.S. farm tractors into tanks and other military vehicles

options.label: B
options.text: The enforcement of rationing to ensure that the U.S. military was properly supplied

options.label: C
options.text: The suspension of U.S. trade with Japan following the attack on Pearl Harbor

options.label: D
options.text: The destruction of U.S. farms and agricultural storage facilities by German bombers

visual_elements: Poster with text: 'We'll have lots to eat this winter, won't we Mother?' and 'Grow your own Can your own' showing a woman and child with jars of canned food.
